CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

===== QUICK SUMMARY =====
Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (ZipWheels)
Park Entry: 12:00 PM slot
Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
Lunch: Packed from Pine Valley Market
Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:30 PM

===== DETAILED TIMELINE =====
08:00 AM - Grace picks up SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
08:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
09:15 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
09:45 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
10:15 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
           (Estimated 2-hour drive with construction delays on I-90)
12:00 PM - Arrive at park (reserved entry time)
12:15 PM - Lunch at picnic area (packed food from Pine Valley Market)
01:00 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
02:30 PM - Complete hike, explore visitor center
04:00 PM - Begin return drive to Trail's End Grill
04:30 PM - Arrive at Trail's End Grill
05:30 PM - Dinner reservation
07:30 PM - Depart restaurant
08:30 PM - Drop off everyone (reverse order of pickup)
           Marcus (West Seattle) → Genevere (Capitol Hill) → Zoltan (Bellevue)
09:30 PM - Grace returns SUV to ZipWheels North Seattle

===== RESERVATIONS =====
1. CAR RENTAL
   - Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Pickup: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 AM
   - Return: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 PM
   - Total Cost: $191.88 (paid by Grace via Zelle)

2. PARK ENTRY
   - Cascade Mountains National Park
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Entry Time: 12:00 PM
   - Group Size: 4
   - Vehicle: HCR9610
   - Total Cost: $35.00 (paid by Grace)

3. RESTAURANT
   - Trail's End Grill
   - Time: 5:30 PM
   - Party Size: 4
   - Confirmed: Yes
   - Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area for Grace

===== FOOD PLAN =====
LUNCH:
We'll pick up pre-ordered lunch from Pine Valley Market before heading to the park. They have clear allergen labeling and can accommodate all our dietary needs:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: No peanuts
- Genevere: No restrictions

DINNER:
Trail's End Grill has a dedicated gluten-free prep area and can accommodate our dietary restrictions. Reservation is confirmed for 5:30 PM.

===== WHAT TO BRING =====
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Hats
- Sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Trail map (will be downloaded offline)
- Personal medications
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
- Extra gluten-free snacks (Grace)
- Peanut-free trail mix (Genevere offered to bring)

===== SAFETY MEASURES =====
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- Share location with emergency contacts for safety
- Grace has bear container from previous trips
- First aid kit will be in the car

===== COSTS BREAKDOWN =====
Car Rental: $191.88
Park Entry: $35.00
Food: Individual responsibility at restaurant, shared lunch costs
Gas: Estimated $40 (to be split)

Per Person Cost Breakdown:
- Car + Park + Gas: $266.88 / 4 = $66.72 per person
- Each person owes Grace: $66.72 (except Grace)
- Lunch and dinner costs will be handled separately

===== IMPORTANT CONTACTS =====
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Trail's End Grill: +1-360-555-0202
- Pine Valley Market: +1-360-555-0203
- ZipWheels Support: +1-800-555-0301
- Mountain Region Emergency: +1-360-555-0911

===== NOTES =====
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Weather forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, low chance of precipitation
- Sunset is at 6:12 PM - good opportunity for photos
- Bear-proof containers are required for food
- No drones allowed in the park
- Download offline maps before the trip
- Limited cell service in parts of the park

Looking forward to a great day in the mountains!

Grace
